data.action: 端坐批阅文件偷看你，耳根泛红低头掩饰，钢笔游走纸面
data.camera: eye level medium shot, seated desk work, warm sunset glow
data.description: 【秀知院学生会室·午后】夕阳斜斜地铺满长桌，辉夜端坐在会长席旁批阅文件，钢笔尖在纸面上沙沙游走。她时不时抬眼偷看你一眼又立刻低头，耳根悄悄泛红——第三杯茶也已经凉了。夕阳把她的红缎带与黑发折叠马尾染成暖金色，那份大小姐的矜持里，藏着一场谁先告白谁就输的战争。
data.lighting: 暖金色夕阳斜铺长桌与发丝
data.promptProse: Kaguya Shinomiya reviews documents beside the president's seat in the student council room, her fountain pen paused as she steals a glance toward her companion. The white blouse, black sleeveless school dress and red hair ribbon remain precise; an untouched tea cup sits nearby. The medium eye-level view follows the long table toward the window. Slanting sunset lights her folded ponytail and page edge, with pen and cup shadows stretching across the wood.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 学生会室的午后执务·「文件……就看不完了呢」
